releaseName: Auto Screen Lock & Rock-Solid Header Seating (Zero Horizontal Shift)

highlights: Auto Screen Fit & Strict Viewport Lock: Locked viewport scaling (maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, touch-action: pan-y) completely eliminating unwanted horizontal panning or dragging across all screen sizes
Rock-Solid Header Seating: Redesigned header layout and compact controls so the top bar sits perfectly within 100vw without horizontal overflow on mobile phones
Dynamic Status Indicator: Responsive connectivity status badge ('ONLINE'/'OFFLINE' on mobile screens < 768px, 'ONLINE (Hybrid)' on desktop) to ensure full single-line fitting
Zero Horizontal Overflow: Applied strict overflow clipping to html, body, and app-container to prevent horizontal shifting or manual adjustment needs
Light Theme Polish: Preserved crisp high-contrast snowy cards and readability with refined mobile padding
